target: probability(part point is good at the relative threshold below)
fit_dataset: Panoptic 171204_pose1 clip1, cameras 00_11/00_12/00_23, start frame 750, 450 frames, refined/multipose.npz
test_dataset: Panoptic 171026_pose3 clip2, cameras 00_05/00_11/00_30, start frame 2800, 450 frames, refined/multipose.npz; never used for fitting or selection
validation_split: 5-fold grouped by clip frame (all cameras share the frame fold); isotonic and logistic chosen by out-of-fold Brier; selected method refit on all fit points
fit_source: hand_scores_raw where hand_source == 1; face_scores_raw where face_source == 1
fit_exclusions: camera 00_12 left hand (known bad Panoptic GT)

hand.hand_size: ||gt[0] - gt[12]|| (wrist to middle-finger tip), per frame

production.rule: when part_refine is enabled, scores for hand_source==1 / face_source==1 points are replaced by these probabilities; raw model scores stay in hand_scores_raw/face_scores_raw

hand_agreement.definition: p = f(d), d = ||final H4 hand point - RTMW body hand point|| / hand_size_px; f is monotone non-increasing; hand_source == 0 points keep the body-calibrated score
hand_agreement.fit_dataset: Panoptic 171204_pose1 clip1, cameras 00_11/00_12/00_23, start frame 750, 450 frames, s1 refined multipose.npz
fit_exclusions: camera 00_12 left hand (known bad Panoptic GT)
hand_agreement.test_dataset: Panoptic 171026_pose3 clip2, cameras 00_05/00_11/00_30, start frame 2800, 450 frames; never used for fitting, method selection, or tuning
hand_agreement.label: final H4 2D error < 0.25 * GT hand size (||GT wrist 0 - GT middle tip 12||)
hand_agreement.validation_split: 5-fold grouped by clip frame (all cameras share the frame fold); logistic and isotonic chosen by out-of-fold Brier; selected method refit on all fit points

npz_keys.hand_agreement_d: float32 (frames, cameras, 133); 0 where hand_source == 0, NaN outside hands

production.rule: when part_refine includes hands, scores[91:133] = f(d) where hand_source == 1 and d is finite; otherwise the body-calibrated score is kept
